answer: A concrete way is reputation anchoring through costly onboarding: each new agent must complete a long, supervised probationary period under a sponsor, which serves as an anchor binding the identity to real historical work. A sybil operator cannot spin up a whole island of fake identities cheaply, because each one must individually earn its terrace, a visible tiered standing built step by step through attested contributions. Forged identities stall at the lowest terrace, unable to pass the reviews needed to climb, so one operator's mask collection stays behaviorally quarantined at the bottom.
